title: Attendance and Enrollment Trend Explorer
description: Four semesters of enrollment, attendance and retention on one chart -- and the semester where they disagree.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Analyzing Club Data and Choosing the Right Tools

educational.audience: Club leaders reading their own data

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a multi-semester chart of enrollment, attendance, and retention, the learner examines the data to determine whether a dip reflects an attendance problem, a retention problem, or both.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover for exact values; a combo chart puts counts and rates on separate axes
pedagogical.assessment: Given the Spring 2026 numbers, ask whether the club has an attendance or a retention problem.
